channel.title: The Kimberley Echo - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Cloud hangs over Derby council election result as WAEC ‘invalidity complaint’ revealed
item.description: The October elections were supposed to herald a fresh start for the beleaguered Shire of Derby, but less than a month after electors headed to the polls the WAEC has filed an “invalidity complaint”.

item.title: Kimberley Remote Aboriginal Communities Leaders Network launches in Broome
item.description: A new community-led initiative, the Kimberley Remote Aboriginal Communities Leaders Network, was launched at Nirrumbuk Environmental Health and Services in Broome on December 3.

item.title: Regional airfare cap renewed, peak prices to climb from 2026
item.description: State government commits $122 million to extend the Regional Airfare Zone Cap scheme until June 2031

item.title: Santa’s stop in Derby
item.description: Holy Rosary School Derby gets in the festive spirit

item.title: Elite athletes inspire East Kimberley youth in AIS Share a Yarn Visit
item.description: Three-time Olympian Mariah Williams, alongside fellow athletes Isabella and Jasmin Guthrie, reflected on their visit to the East Kimberley as part of AIS’s Share a Yarn program earlier this year.

item.title: Kununurra childcare centre gets new operator as SAT documents reveal shocking safety incident
item.description: Shire of Wyndham-East Kimberley Council approves immediate change in management for a Kununurra daycare centre as SAT documents reveal details of shocking safety incident involving previous operator.

item.title: Weather: Broome, Kimberley warned to brace for damaging winds, rain as Tropical Cyclone Hayley bears down
item.description: West Aussies have been warned to brace for a major storm and possible evacuations as a tropical cyclone is expected to hit the coast on New Year’s Eve.

item.title: Weather: Tropical Cyclone Hayley watch and act issued as warnings escalate across Kimberley region
item.description: A tropical cyclone warning for the Kimberley has those in the region on high alert as they prepare to ride out the storm.

item.title: Tropical Cyclone Hayley: Storm crosses Kimberley coast packing 157km/h winds, tears roofs off homes
item.description: Authorities are assessing the damage caused by Tropical Cyclone Hayley after it crossed the WA coast, bringing heavy winds and rain and widespread power outages.

item.title: Banned drinkers register made permanent in Pilbara and Kimberley after successful NW trial
item.description: After a five-year trial, the banned drinkers register has now become permanent in the Pilbara and Kimberley.
